findings.detail: The target tree contains only PROPOSAL.json and no implementation source. Consequently there is no code to verify for train-only covariance estimation, the specified shrinkage-whitening transform, feeding transformed vectors to the unchanged RQ-VAE, or exporting one SID tuple per item. Mechanism fidelity cannot be established.
findings.reproduction: Enumerate files under the target tree: the only file is PROPOSAL.json. There is no trainer, preprocessing/transform implementation, export code, or test in this tree.
findings.correction: Provide the implementation in this tree, including the fixed alpha=0.05 train-only transform and its use consistently during training and export; then review the actual code against the specification.

findings.detail: No forward/backward implementation is present, so finite losses, gradient reachability, dead loss terms, and numerical stability cannot be checked or reproduced. A proposal is not executable evidence of trainability.
findings.reproduction: There is no Python/module or test file in the target tree to invoke for a real forward and backward pass.
findings.correction: Include the runnable model/training entry point and a minimal real-batch forward/backward check; verify finite loss and gradients for the intended RQ-VAE parameters and inspect the transform/eigendecomposition for numerical stability.

findings.detail: The tree has no trainer entry point, data-loading path, SID export, or distributed launcher configuration. Therefore the real trainer cannot be run, frozen-data provenance and SID indexing/validity cannot be checked, and launcher compatibility cannot be confirmed.
findings.reproduction: The target tree contains only PROPOSAL.json; attempts to identify a trainer or launcher within it yield no files to run or inspect.
findings.correction: Provide the integrated implementation and its actual entry point/configuration. Run it against the frozen data path, validate exported SIDs against item indices and expected tuple format, and exercise the distributed launcher before verification.
